name: R R Kabel Ltd.
about: R R Kabel Limited manufactures and sells wires and cables, and fast-moving electrical goods under the RR Signature brand name in India and internationally. It offers house wires, industrial wires, low and medium voltage power cables, solar, and special cables. The company also provides fans, lighting, switches, switchgear, and other accessories; and water heaters, room heaters, iron, air coolers, and kitchen appliances. Its products are used in residential, commercial, industrial, and infrastructure sectors. The company was formerly known as Ram Ratna Agro-Plast Limited and changed its name to R R Kabel Limited in November 2000. R R Kabel Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Mumbai, India.

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~37% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~23% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 17.2% cost of equity).
PE of 30 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 55), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 30 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 43 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 49% a year while PE moved 70 → 30.
